verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page mentions "AI-powered search" as part of its development-lifecycle tooling. That is a first-party search capability, but it is never described as searching code or spanning multiple repositories. The community complaint about being unable to browse or search public projects concerns project discovery, not code search, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of code search, cross-repository scope, query syntax or filters, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
